_comment: Subsystem modules for module-scoped audits (Development_Tools/ModuleMap/module_map.py). The framework is mostly C#, so modules follow the code's own folders and responsibilities (CLAUDE.md Framework Scope); its few cards (Metal Parts, the Portal hub) get their own modules. Every tracked file belongs to exactly one module, is a sharedTable (rows attributed by the UID or LocalizationKey they name), or is a picture/.art file owned by the module whose card names it. `module_map.py check CSFFModFramework` must exit 0.

modules.name: Core and Mod-wide
modules.summary: Plugin entry, ModInfo, csproj, docs and licenses, shared utilities (Util, ReflectionCache), the LitJSON stub, SafePatcher and art review state.

modules.name: Public API
modules.summary: The Api/ facade content mods compile against: ContentModPlugin, Framework, GameQuery, SpawnService, Inventory, StatAccess, TickEvents, Gate, RecipeInjector, BlueprintAlternates, WorldMap, Npc and the rest of the contract surface.

modules.name: Mod Discovery
modules.summary: Finding and classifying installed mods: ModDiscovery, ModManifest (ModLoader ownership and framework-only markers), ModAssets, ModTag and plugin dependency reading.

modules.name: Load Pipeline and Data
modules.summary: LoadOrchestrator and GameLoadPatch phases, JsonDataLoader, Data/ (Database, GameRegistry, DataMap, WarpResolver, GameSourceModifier, ExtraDataStore), UID aliases, clones, foreign-instance reconcile, normalizers, index repairs, stale-content cleanup, AlwaysUpdate, authoring lint and the VanillaIds registry.

modules.name: Sprites, Audio and Localization
modules.summary: SpriteLoader, SpriteResolver, SpriteTextureCache, AudioLoader, AssetBundleLoader, LocalizationLoader, the vanilla-key default-text repair and LocalizationPatch.

modules.name: Declarative Content Injectors
modules.summary: Blueprint tabs and container fix, perks (injection, relocation, origin tag, starting stats), drops, improvements, smelting, tag groups (TagGroups.json), cross-slot matching rules (MatchAcross), trading values, flavour matrix, modifier packages, quests, STA activation and the blueprint flag fix.

modules.name: World Map and Travel
modules.summary: WorldMapLoader and WorldMapInjector (clone nodes, travel DAs), CoordRegistry, env capacity, connection and sealable gates, conditional drops, strip-all contamination check, map cache and the travel-path crash guards.

modules.name: Portal Hub
modules.summary: Map-mod portals: PortalService, PortalRegistry, MapModLoader, PortalTravelPatch, the arrival guard, the Portal Kit and placed portal, hub exit, Wayfinder perk and the animated portal GIF.

modules.name: GIF and Card Motion
modules.summary: Animated card art (Gif/ loader, frame sets, player, GifAnimationPatch) and card motion profiles (Motion/, CardMotionPatch).

modules.name: Animals and Wildlife
modules.summary: Declarative animals (loader, schema, validator, encounters, tracks, traps, taming, companions, duties, lifecycle), wildlife raids, expired-track pruning and the wildlife-stuck diagnostic.

modules.name: Encounters, NPCs and Triggers
modules.summary: Encounter guards (loader and both patches), character rosters, NPC agent activation, NPC action-row and button-text fixes, and spawn triggers (Triggers/).

modules.name: Bug Fixes and Mod Compatibility
modules.summary: Vanilla crash guards and UI fixes not tied to one subsystem (blueprint screen, drag start, null tag, passive multiplier cancel, stale save cards) and third-party compatibility (CardSizeReduce scale, Cheats, WikiMod).

modules.name: Performance and Diagnostics
modules.summary: Catch-up tick batching, caps and budget clamp, off-screen and off-env throttles, DOTween prewarm, ambience reuse, log suppression, and the opt-in autosave, frame, tracking, catch-up and blueprint search diagnostics.

modules.name: Shared Metal Parts
modules.summary: Metal Sheet, Metal Nails (copper, cast copper, iron) and Tin Solder cards and blueprints shared by content mods, with their metal-variant pictures and smelting rows.

modules.name: Lamp Oil and Stearin Cake
modules.summary: Lamp Oil (APE_LQ_LampOil), the Stearin Cake (APE_StearinCake) and the Lamp Oil blueprint hosted from Chiwei's Additional Processing Equipment, with the framework GameSourceModify patches they need (fish Mince actions, clay bowl picture, Fat or Wax and Waterproofing Agent groups) and their picture recipes.

modules.name: Brine and Brine Curing
modules.summary: Brine (APE_LQ_SaltWater) and Concentrated Brine (APE_LQ_SaltSyrup) hosted from Chiwei's Additional Processing Equipment, the Brine's salting effect, the soaking cards Meat in Brine and Fish in Brine, and Salt-Cured Meat and Fish (moved from Advanced Copper Tools under its UIDs) with their pictures. The Salt and Clay Bowl GameSourceModify patches that make Brine and cure in it sit in the lampoil module's GameSourceModify/**.

modules.name: Per-Card Saved Values
modules.summary: Api.CardState (2.29.0, fleet plan 6.3): named float values on one in-game card, keyed by a random id in the card's DroppedCollections, saved in a sidecar per save file under the slot's CSFFModFramework folder, pruned to the ids each written save still holds, and carried through transforms and blueprints by a per-name policy. The public facade Api/CardState.cs sits in the api module.
